messages:
maria-cs: Quick heads up — OrionSys onboarding health is degrading. 90th pct latency up ~2.3x this week vs their baseline and error rate ticked after onboarding traffic ramp. Renewal in ~6 weeks so want to be proactive with a performance + quality plan.

maria-cs: Proposal: trial an int8 quant swap to redwood/xlm-compact-1-int8 for their low-memory paths + split routing so EU traffic hits eu-west pool. Ask: can ML/eng run a small eval on their top 50 prompts and a 200-sample recent request set? Link: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/orionsys/perf (internal) :eyes:

tj-ml: +1. I can run evals tomorrow morning. Do we already have a sanitized prompt set? If not, we should capture ~200 recent requests from their prod window and scrub PII first.

tj-ml: Quick checks I'll run: token-level perplexity, response quality (ROUGE + semantic similarity), and a heuristics-based hallucination score. If int8 drops quality >1% on those metrics we pivot to a hybrid int16-distill profile.

ash-eng: routing/ops note — split routing is straightforward. Recommend a canary flow: 5% -> 20% with auto-fallback to their current model if any regression triggers. We can also route only non-critical endpoints first (e.g., suggestion endpoints vs legal doc gen).

ash-eng: I'll provision the eu-west dedicated pool spare capacity for this canary; we have headroom. Also will coordinate with infra to watch KV cache warmup impact.

maria-cs: I'll ping the customer for permission to run the prompt sample and explain the canary window (30–45m). Also capturing their tolerance: how much latency reduction is priority vs any quality delta.

ash-eng: sample routing config I'll use for the canary:

```yaml
routing:
  - match: customer_id == "orionsys"
    weight:
      redwood/xlm-compact-1-int8: 0.05
      redwood/xlm-default: 0.95
canary_policy:
  steps: [5, 20]
  fallback: redwood/xlm-default
monitoring:
  metrics: [p95_latency, token_cost, hallucination_score]
  alert_thresholds:
    hallucination_score: 0.01
```

tj-ml: Perfect. When I post results I'll include a tiny diff snippet showing example output regressions (if any) and a recommended model profile (int8 vs int16-hybrid).

deploy-bot: Canary job created — id canary-2864527890-01; targets: 5% of OrionSys traffic -> redwood/xlm-compact-1-int8; status: starting.

maria-cs: Thanks team — I'll log this as a preemptive renewal playbook item and schedule a 15m sync with OrionSys CSM + eng review after the eval. Will update thread once customer OKs sample capture.
summary: Proactive canary plan for OrionSys: int8 quant trial + split routing to eu-west; ask to run evals and capture customer consent
